kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: A second judge blocks Trump's arch, saying it's unlikely to succeed in court
wire.summary: A federal judge in Virginia said she will issue a preliminary injunction against Trump's arch, going a step further than the D.C. federal judge who temporarily blocked construction earlier this week.

wire.title: Trump initially accepted the midterm results, but most GOP voters doubt they were fair
wire.summary: Less than half of Republicans nationwide considered the midterm elections "free and fair," according to new polling.

wire.title: How Orchestra Noir turned classical music into a cultural movement
wire.summary: Orchestra Noir is back on tour, selling out stages across the country and proving classical music can be anything you want it to be.

wire.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers little results
wire.summary: At a White House press conference Friday, Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues.

wire.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain
wire.summary: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.

wire.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa
wire.summary: Congress needs to pass a funding measure to avoid a shutdown next month, providing Dems an opportunity to leverage power. And, the Army says waiting to detonate lead azide could become dangerous.

wire.title: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
wire.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

wire.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
wire.summary: "We're not going to shut down the war," Sen. Ron Johnson said as Republicans and Democrats struggle to reach a government funding deal.

wire.title: Senate passes bipartisan energy bill amid environmental concerns
wire.summary: As Americans struggle with rising energy costs and increased demand driven by AI, the Senate passed a bipartisan bill that will speed up the approval process for data centers and power plants.

wire.title: New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
wire.summary: New York City officials are moving forward with plans to close Rikers, the city's main jail complex, after years of discussion. The jail has been plagued by assaults and inmate deaths.

wire.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
wire.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

wire.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
wire.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

wire.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
wire.summary: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

wire.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
wire.summary: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

wire.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
wire.summary: Other tech companies have also taken a hit as share markets broadly slump.

wire.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
wire.summary: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.
